tool.name: add_circle
tool.description: Adds exactly one circle and returns the permanent number assigned to it. Call this once per circle the user asked for; do not repeat the call after it succeeds. Fails if 6 circles already exist.

arg.name: color
arg.description: Colour for the new circle. Defaults to red if not given.

tool.name: remove_circle
tool.description: Removes the circle with this number. Other circles keep their own numbers, so it is safe to remove several circles in one go using the numbers from a single list_circles call.

arg.name: number
arg.description: The circle's permanent number, as shown on it and reported by list_circles. Not a position, so do not assume the circles are numbered 1 upwards.

tool.name: set_circle_color
tool.description: Changes the colour of one circle by its number, or of every circle if no number is given.

arg.name: number
arg.description: The circle's permanent number. Leave out to recolour all of them.

tool.name: list_circles
tool.description: Reports every circle on screen with its permanent number and colour. Numbers can have gaps. Call this first whenever the user refers to a circle by colour or position rather than by number.
